name: Keaton D. West
residence: Rock Springs, Sweetwater County (campaign website: born and raised in Rock Springs and has lived his life in the county aside from college at the University of Wyoming)
occupation: Sweetwater County commissioner; the county's commissioner listing identifies him as Keaton D. West, and his campaign site says he has served as commission chairman
education: His campaign website lists a Bachelor of Applied Science in Organizational Leadership and states that he attended the University of Wyoming (it does not explicitly say the degree is from UW)
prior_offices: Sweetwater County commissioner (2023–present, including service as chairman, per his campaign site); previously Rock Springs City Council (2019–2022, including council president in 2022), Rock Springs Planning & Zoning Commission (2017–2019), Sweetwater County Parks & Recreation Board (2013–2018, president 2014–2016), and Rock Springs Chamber of Commerce board (2012–2015, president 2015), per his campaign website
background: Keaton D. West is a Sweetwater County commissioner, first seated in 2023 and re-elected in 2026. On his campaign website he wrote that he was born and raised in Rock Springs, has lived his life in Sweetwater County aside from attending college at the University of Wyoming, and listed a Bachelor of Applied Science in Organizational Leadership. The site lists prior service on the Rock Springs City Council, including as council president in 2022, and earlier service on the city's planning and zoning commission, the county parks and recreation board, and the Rock Springs Chamber of Commerce board, including terms as president of the latter two. The county's commissioner profiles list him among the current board; his campaign site says he has served as commission chairman.
